sloka: अवध्या मम ते देवाः सुकेशतनया रणे ।मन्त्रं तु वः प्रदास्यामि यस्तान्वै निहनिष्यति ।। ७.६.२९ ॥
transliteration: avadhyā mama te devāḥ sukeśatanayā raṇe ।mantraṁ tu vaḥ pradāsyāmi yastānvai nihaniṣyati ।। 7.6.29 ॥

translations.english: Having thus been addressed by the gods and having heard their plea, the destroyer of Andhaka (Shiva), shaking his head and hand, spoke these words.
